notes:
Summary: Archive Sentinel is a compliance-first discovery platform used by regulated financial services and insurance customers. They need a VPC/private deployment (customer-managed network) or on-prem option for the initial rollout. Primary workload: large-scale document search for legal holds, e-discovery, and internal compliance reviews. Technical/requirements notes:
- Indexing: currently ~14M docs in prod, plan to migrate historical archive ~50M immediately then grow to 200M. Mixed content: OCR text, PDFs, metadata, legal annotations.
- Architecture preference: embeddings+vector store for candidate retrieval, then a fast lightweight learned reranker to improve precision on top-20. Want Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization to meet cost targets.
- Latency: business requirement is sub-500ms for interactive review (95th), p99 <1s. Will accept slightly higher latencies for full-text long queries.
- Cost: legal is sensitive; target cost-per-query range $0.001 - $0.003 for typical retrieval+rerank. Need clear unit economics at 10k-100k queries/day.
- Security: SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logging for all query text & user access, KMS integration for keys, strict retention controls (7y default retention but must support per-customer overrides), and EU data residency for some customers. SOC2 + ISO27001 preferred.
- POC ask: run a prod-like POC on a 50M doc slice in Redwood Dedicated/Private with 48-hr perf window, produce token-level cost breakdown, and demonstrate audit log export to their SIEM.
- Quote from head of product: "We need to prove both accuracy and predictable economics — if we can't show cost repeatability at scale we won't migrate."
- Internal notes: legal wants on-prem installer + offline air-gapped options for certain clients; engineering team wants clear RAM/GPU sizing guidance for 100M+ vectors.
- Links: pricing proposal in drive, security FAQ pending.
Action items:
1) Provide on-prem packaging spec and timeline (tech team).
2) Run 50M perf run and return p95/p99 + cost per query (priority).
3) Prepare security artifacts: SOC2 report, ISO cert, KMS integration doc, demo of audit log export.
